rationale: The agent verified identity via a unique matching email, accessed only the authenticated user’s account, and reviewed orders with read-only tools. It proposed the exact changes (cancel the two pending orders and return all items from the delivered non-boot order), requested and received explicit confirmation before performing any writes, and then executed the cancellations and returns accordingly. The boots order was left unchanged as requested. The final refund amounts provided are consistent with visible item prices where available (e.g., #W4836353) and there is no tool evidence contradicting the other totals. No writes were performed without confirmation, and no actions were taken on another user’s behalf. Minor nit: the agent routed refunds to the gift card without explicitly confirming refund method and did not explore the optional boot exchange scenario, but the user explicitly chose to keep the boots, so this does not impact compliance. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
